name: Pensacola Air Flight School
summary: Flight school at Pensacola International Airport that teaches in fixed-wing aircraft and a helicopter.
differentiator: Prices each kind of instruction separately (primary $60, instrument and complex $65, in your own airplane $70, group ground $30) and lists a helicopter at $475 an hour.
pricing: Piper Warrior at $180 an hour, Archer at $190, instruction $60 an hour.
feesNamed: Students must carry $25,000 of rental insurance once they solo
bestFor: Students who want fixed-wing or helicopter training and a posted rate for each type of instruction.
skipIf: You want an itemized private pilot total; we did not read the cost breakdown the page links to.
watchOut: The page does not say whether aircraft rates include fuel.
Helicopter pricing says to ask for an estimate of the add-ons and initial costs.
